# The creation of Wonder Woman

Wonder Woman was created by psychologist William Moulton Marston, with artist Harry G. Peter. She first appeared in All Star Comics #8 in 1941.

Marston wanted a heroine who would win through strength combined with compassion and truth. Her Lasso of Truth echoes his interest in lie detection; Marston had worked on an early form of the lie-detector test.

Wonder Woman, Superman and Batman are often called DC's "trinity", because all three have been published almost continuously since the early 1940s.
